ValidationRule.description: Separation of duties: only a holder of Can_Clear_Escalation may close an escalation. Blocks the true-to-false transition only. Enforced here, not in the flow, because a flow governs only its own path — a direct or API edit would bypass it.
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Only a senior credit analyst can close an escalation. This file was routed for senior review; ask the assigned owner to clear it.
